name: Clerical Training Room
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: A mailed cleric stands here smiling, ready to train the righteous. He
desc4: is responsible for both training initiates in the fighting arts and in
desc5: the temple's doctrine, both of which he must be well versed in. To the
desc6: south you can see the magnificent temple hall.
